signal.title: IcFuzz: Fuzzing Isaac Sim with Semantic Stage Guidance and Multi-level Mutation
signal.summary: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。

editorial.intro: 这项研究利用仿真或三维场景生成，为具身智能提供训练、测试和安全验证所需的可控环境。
editorial.why_it_matters: 高质量仿真能够降低真实机器人试错成本，但关键在于生成环境是否保留了任务和物理约束。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对仿真与真实环境之间的差距，以及是否能复现到真实机器人。

evidence.title: IcFuzz: Fuzzing Isaac Sim with Semantic Stage Guidance and Multi-level Mutation
evidence.excerpt: Robotics simulators serve as a foundational infrastructure for embodied AI, facilitating safe and scalable robotic system development. NVIDIA Isaac Sim has emerged as one of the most popular simulators, distinguished by its GPU-accelerated physics engine and photorealistic rendering, which enable high-fidelity modeling of complex environments. However, its inherent complexity inevitably introduces software bugs that can compromise simulation reliability. Existing fuzzing approaches struggle to test Isaac Sim effectively due to challenges of context-aware object semantics, hierarchical simulation control, and a vast simulation state space. In this paper, we propose IcFuzz, the first fuzzing approach for Isaac Sim. IcFuzz first performs an LLM-based semantic stage segmentation, decomposing simulation programs into structured stages that capture context-aware object semantics. Guided by this information, IcFuzz designs multi-level mutation operators to systematically exercise the simulator across hierarchical granularities.
